english.note: Use this especially for a physical object, machine, or system that is broken or not working.

exampleSentences.english: The photocopier is faulty and cannot print documents.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部影印機壞咗，印唔到文件。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 jing2 jan3 gei1 waai6 zo2 jan3 m4 dou3 man4 gin6

english.note: Use this especially when the damaged object is faulty or no longer working, such as a machine.

exampleSentences.english: The fan is damaged and won't turn on.
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 fung1 sin3 waai6 zo2 hoi1 m4 dou2

english.note: Use 壞 as the all-purpose choice when a system or machine is not functioning; for an aircraft, it covers mechanical failure only.

exampleSentences.english: The air conditioner is down and won't turn on.
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 waai6 zo2 hoi1 m4 dou2

english.note: Use this for a damaged or invalid file, text, or other digital or technical item, often said as 壞咗.

exampleSentences.english: The file is corrupt, so I can't open it.
exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 dong2 on3 waai6 zo2 hoi1 m4 dou2

english.note: Use 壞 when something is not working or is out of order.

exampleSentences.english: Something is wrong with the air conditioner.
